name: ICENTS
recent: iCents Group 近期获得两份与半导体设施相关的合约，潜在总值约 RM36.15 million，并在 Selangor 进行 EPCC 工程。公司同时宣布将于 2026 年 11 月 27 日召开第二届常年股东大会。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收同比增长 89.4%，但净利转亏。
notable: 获得一份潜在价值 RM36.15 million 的 Selangor 半导体晶圆设施开发合约。
获得一份来自美国公司的 RM21 million EPCC 工程合约，并可能追加约 RM15 million 工程。
risks: 董事 IR Ts. Ong Mum Fei 于 2026 年 9 月 10 日出售 15,000,000 股（3.000%）。
执行董事 Mr Foo Siang Leng 于 2026 年 9 月 10 日出售 15,000,000 股（3.000%）。
最新季度净亏损 RM1.246 million，净利率为 -3.5%。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM35.567 million，环比增长 7.1%，同比增长 89.4%；净亏损为 RM1.246 million，净利率 -3.5%，上一季度净利率为 10.8%。

recent_en: iCents Group recently secured two semiconductor facility-related contracts with a potential total value of about RM36.15 million for EPCC works in Selangor. The company also announced its 2nd Annual General Meeting to be held on 27 November 2026. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 89.4% year-on-year but the company swung to a net loss.
notable_en: Secured a contract with a potential value of RM36.15 million to develop a semiconductor wafer facility in Selangor.
Secured a RM21 million EPCC contract from a US-based company, with potential additional works of about RM15 million.
Two directors each disposed of 15,000,000 ordinary shares (3.000% each) on 10 September 2026.
risks_en: Director IR Ts. Ong Mum Fei disposed of 15,000,000 shares (3.000%) on 10 September 2026.
Executive Director Mr Foo Siang Leng disposed of 15,000,000 shares (3.000%) on 10 September 2026.
The latest quarter recorded a net loss of RM1.246 million with a net margin of -3.5%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM35.567 million, up 7.1% QoQ and 89.4% YoY; net loss was RM1.246 million with a net margin of -3.5%, compared with a net margin of 10.8% in the previous quarter.
